name: Parabel-Kuzbass Gas Pipeline Second Line (Novokuznetsk)
monitor_reason: length (no sourced length; local Novokuznetsk segment, likely <25 km but unknown) and concrete step (only a governor's proposal entered in a federal gasification meeting protocol; no design, permit, tender or FID)
researcher_notes: Single source (AIF Kuzbass, Jan 2025): Governor Seredyuk proposed moving completion of the second line of the Parabel-Kuzbass main gas pipeline in Novokuznetsk from 2029 to 2027, to avoid gas shutdowns during annual maintenance of the existing line; entered into the protocol by Deputy PM Novak at a Siberian FD regasification meeting. Sponsor implied Gazprom; no length, endpoints, diameter, design status, permit or tender given. Two further searches (Russian) found no length or design milestone. Match check: P7615 (Nizhnevartovsk-Parabel-Kuzbass II, Vertikos->Novokuznetsk, operating, 714 km) is the existing second string, so this 'second line in Novokuznetsk' is either a local loop/bypass or an unclear reference to it; cannot be resolved without a length or endpoints, so not matched_existing and not new_row. P4056 (Novokuznetsk-Prokopyevsk, proposed, length blank) is a different corridor (Novokuznetsk to Prokopyevsk, cap 0.78 bcm/y) and does not match. Watch for Gazprom/Kuzbass project documents giving endpoints and km.
